Find the missing values in the following truth table:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,A∨(B∧A)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-1}} |

| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-4}} |
questions.worked_solution:
First, we complete a truth table for the part in parentheses, $B∧A.$  The statement $B∧A$ is true if both $A$ and $B$ are true.

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,B∧A\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |

Then, we look at the columns labeled $A$ and $B∧A$ to complete the column $A∨(B∧A).$ The statement $A∨(B∧A)$ is true if either $A$ is true, $B∧A$ is true, or both $A$ and $B∧A$ are true. 

The completed truth table is shown below:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,B∧A\,$ | $\,A∨(B∧A)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |

questions.problem:
Find the missing values in the following truth table:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,(B∧A)∨B\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-1}} |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-2}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-3}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-4}} |
questions.worked_solution:
First, we complete a truth table for the part in parentheses, $B∧A.$ The statement $B∧A$ is true if both $A$ and $B$ are true.

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,B∧A\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |

Then, we look at the columns labeled $B∧A$ and the column $B$ to complete the column $(B∧A)∨B.$ The statement $(B∧A)∨B$ is true if either $B∧A$ is true, $B$ is true, or both $B∧A$ and $B$ are true.

The completed truth table is shown below:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,B∧A\,$ | $\,(B∧A)∨B\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |

questions.problem:
Find the missing values in the following truth table:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,B∨(A∧(B∨A))\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-1}} |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-2}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | {{field-3}} |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | {{field-4}} |
questions.worked_solution:
First, we complete a truth table for the part in the inner-most parentheses, $B∨A.$ The statement $B∨A$ is true if either $A$ is true, $B$ is true, or both $A$ and $B$ are true.

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,B∨A\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |

Next, we look at the columns labeled $A$ and $B∨A$ to complete a truth table for the part in the outer-most parentheses, $A∧(B∨A).$ The statement $A∧(B∨A)$ is true if both $A$ and $B∨A$ are true.

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,B∨A\,$ | $\,A∧(B∨A)\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |

Finally, we look at the columns labeled $B$ and $A∧(B∨A)$ to complete the column $B∨(A∧(B∨A)).$ The statement $B∨(A∧(B∨A))$ is true if either $B$ is true, $A∧(B∨A)$ is true, or both $B$ and $A∧(B∨A)$ are true.

The completed truth table is shown below:

| $\,A\,$ | $\,B\,$ | $\,B∨A\,$ | $\,A∧(B∨A)\,$ | $\,B∨(A∧(B∨A))\,$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{T}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{T}$ |
| $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ | $\text{F}$ |
